title: Intent (v0)
description: A demand-stance request. Structured as the three-tier model from docs/spec/01 §P3: grouping_keys (coarse, shared, used to partition) vs constraints (hard filters) vs preferences (soft, ranked, and trigger collaboration on failure). Nothing participant-specific may appear in grouping_keys.

grouping_keys.description: TIER 1 (docs/spec/01 §P3). Coarse, shared, category-defined dimensions that place this request into a matchable partition. MUST NOT contain anything participant-specific. Shape is category-defined; validated against the category's grouping-key schema.

constraints.description: TIER 2. Hard must-satisfy requirements, applied as filters WITHIN a partition. Not grouping keys.

preferences.description: TIER 3. Soft, individual desires. Used only for RANKING (by the operator, §P10) and to trigger collaboration on failure (§P5). Never a grouping key, never a hard filter. Category-specific shape validated against the category's intent-ext schema.

coalition_opt_in.description: Whether this intent may join a demand-side Coalition on match failure (§P1 — demand only; §P5 — on failure).

created_at.description: Enqueue time. FIFO ordering within a partition is by this field (§P6).
